name: McAfee Knob
where: Appalachian Trail on Catawba Mountain, VA 311 near Catawba, northwest of Salem and Roanoke, Virginia
blurb: The overhanging ledge of McAfee Knob, the most photographed spot on the Appalachian Trail, plus the quartzite spire of Dragon’s Tooth: two of Virginia’s Triple Crown above the Catawba Valley.

trails.name: McAfee Knob from the Catawba Sustainability Center

status: open: VA 311 lot fills early on spring and fall weekends (no parking on VA 311, towing); McAfee Knob Trailhead Shuttle runs Fri–Sun through Nov 29, 2026; no camping or fires on McAfee Knob, overnight camping only at designated A.T. shelters and campsites.
